subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open conflicting fork PR for this Debug Snapshots repair, or close/supersede it and queue a fresh current-main fix?
rationale: The bug is still valid, but an open linked fork PR already claims the repair and is conflicting against the current route-owned Debug page, so automation should not open a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow fix against the current `ui/src/pages/debug/*` implementation with localization, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase The Fork PR
options.body: Keep the contributor path, but require it to rebase onto current main, move from the old view path, add localized copy and tests, and provide real behavior proof.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Diagnostics Work
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer the Snapshots-specific feedback until maintainers combine it with the broader Control UI diagnostics work.

recommendation.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow fix against the current `ui/src/pages/debug/*` implementation with localization, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the original Debug dashboard surface and is the strongest available routing candidate for choosing whether to replace or adopt the stale linked path.
